regionalNotesEnglish: Qualified site and waste-handling review is needed for nail sweep, gutter access, disposal and final-site acceptance.
France/Québec terms for dumpster, downspout and magnetic sweep require regional trade review.

sourceDecisionQuestions.question: Dumpster, downspout and gutter are regional trade senses. Confirm whether archived benne à déchets and descente pluviale fit the selected locale and disposal system; do not silently narrow the English source in scored vocabulary.

The source calls for a magnet and every-nail pickup. Archived l’aimant de ramassage and ramassage magnétique specify a pickup tool/process. A magnetic sweep alone cannot verify every nail was collected or that the area is safe; keep this site-acceptance question internal while preserving the source task.

Yard/patio may mean a yard, courtyard or surrounding site depending on the property; archived la cour is a candidate, not an approved universal equivalent. Confirm local site and French regional usage.

The source assigns a gutter check before departure. Determine approved access and final-site check procedure for this job; archived speaking adds accessible zones and plan confirmation beyond the pinned source objective and stays separate evidence.
